  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-zstd.b2frame","function":"<global>","line":null,"var":"input frame bytes","code":"Seed frame file consumed by the fuzz target","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are parsed as a Blosc2 frame and drive chunk lookup and decompression."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"schunk","code":"blosc2_schunk* schunk = blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false);","note":"The raw input is wrapped as an in-memory frame-backed super-chunk without copying or validation beyond frame parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":33,"var":"nchunk","code":"for (i = 0, nchunk = 0; nchunk < schunk->nchunks-1; nchunk++) {","note":"The fuzzer iterates over every chunk index reported by the parsed frame, so malformed metadata can influence later chunk access."},
  {"step":4,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":0,"var":"frame","code":"blosc2_frame_s* frame = (blosc2_frame_s*)schunk->frame; if (frame != NULL) return frame_decompress_chunk(schunk->dctx, frame, nchunk, dest, nbytes);","note":"Decompression dispatches into the frame path, carrying the attacker-controlled frame object into chunk retrieval."},
  {"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":2761,"var":"src","code":"rc = frame_get_lazychunk(frame, nchunk, &src, &needs_free);","note":"The chunk is fetched as a lazy chunk, which may allocate a temporary buffer and later require a matching free."},
  {"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1935,"var":"*chunk","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes); *needs_free = true;","note":"For disk-backed or reconstructed chunks, the function allocates a new buffer and marks it as owned by the caller."},
  {"step":7,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":2788,"var":"src","code":"if (needs_free) { free(src); }","note":"The caller frees the lazy chunk after decompression; if the returned pointer aliases memory not owned by malloc, this becomes an invalid free sink."}
]
